exposure: mode of delivery of the last pregnancy
cohort: The study included 349 women of reproductive age who attended Sri Kembangan Polyclinic in Serdang, Selangor.
finding: The prevalence of family planning practice among women in Serdang was 38.4%, with marital status, religion, number of children, and positive attitude being statistically significant factors contributing to family planning practice.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery of the last pregnancy was significantly associated with family planning practice (p=0.001).
